hypothesis: Exact equality of source-dependent empirical outcome distributions under every source withdrawal can be decided by Boolean polynomial identities plus equality of nonempty-evidence conditions, without enumerating all source subsets.
scope: A local exact-arithmetic prerequisite for retractable predictive-state abstraction. No learned agent, memory-product change, novelty, timing superiority, or held-out result is claimed.
contract: Each observation has a positive integer multiplicity, one outcome, and an AND dependency on at most three source identities. A withdrawal removes all observations depending on any withdrawn source. Readout is the exact normalized outcome histogram, or a distinct unknown value when no observations survive. Source identities remain shared. Absolute counts, individual episodes, temporal last-write selection and arbitrary future insertions are outside this readout contract.
candidate: Represent counts as multilinear polynomials in source-survival bits. Compare minimal source-support antichains, then reduce each cross-multiplied probability difference modulo x_i^2=x_i. A nonzero difference yields a concrete withdrawal witness. Its size is at most twice the largest provenance width; support/unknown discrepancies can require more withdrawals.
controls: cross multiplication without unknown-state support checking negative control
global-gcd-normalized source histograms as a sound but incomplete structural control
acceptance: Zero candidate/oracle disagreements; every returned witness changes the readout; every distribution-only witness respects the 2g bound; required empty-evidence counterexample defeats the naive bound. Record structural-control disagreements and all failed hypotheses. No performance promotion without a per-outcome algebraic decision-diagram control and a complete state-abstraction workload.
